text: Lookout cams on the ridges above Barrington Tops need watching for open flame and rising smoke columns through the bushfire season, with any hit routed to the fire tower desk. This one isn't a rush.

hey, can we hook the new air sniffer in the nail salon back room up to something that reports TVOC in ppb? acetone and acrylic fumes get pretty heavy by the afternoon. crunching the numbers in the cloud is totally fine, and decent-enough readings are plenty for us

Clause 4.2 (Footfall Analytics). The Provider shall convert the walking paths of shoppers captured across the airport duty-free concourse into zone-by-zone occupancy heatmaps for merchandising review. Path data may be transmitted to and processed at off-premises facilities. Requests under this clause shall be handled on an expedited, top-priority basis.
Corridor Monitor: loop and camera feeds along the Parramatta Road corridor are live. Please derive vehicles-per-kilometre density and mean travel speed for each segment. No expedite needed.
Hey assistant, start tracking rotor imbalance and ice accretion on the composite blades of turbine seven out at the offshore array, good-enough accuracy works, and there's no hurry on this one.

Hi Marta, Following last week's low-oxygen event at the salmon pens off Bruny Island, we'd like a system that manages the aerators so dissolved oxygen in each pen stays inside the target saturation band, stepping air delivery up or down as conditions change. Could you look into whether your platform can take this on? Thanks, Jonas

Paint shop, line 3 at the assembly plant: clear-coated doors and bonnets coming out of the oven need checking for orange-peel texture and fine hairline scratches in the clear coat before final trim. Inspection has to be top-accuracy since dealers reject anything visible under showroom lights. Push this to the front of the queue.

yo, for the drone depot on the roof of the logistics hub, we want something to run the robotic arm that pulls flat battery packs out of the delivery drones and slots charged ones in. fine if the control logic runs off-site in the cloud, but every swap has to be done with top-grade precision. no rush though

The Provider shall, for every reed-switch door contact alarm raised at the data centre's cage entrances, check the matching CCTV footage to confirm or dismiss a break-in. Alarm events and associated clips may be analysed at the Provider's remote facilities. Baseline-grade analytic accuracy is acceptable for this service. Each alarm shall be processed with immediate priority.

Photo Library App: we need a catch-all detector that finds whatever items appear in uploaded pictures and draws a box around each one, for images none of the specialised models handle. Processing can happen on a cloud server.

Hey, set up spotting for forklifts and those self-driving tuggers in the lumber yard's loading shed video, keep all the footage inside our own yard systems, and make it the most accurate model you've got.

Hi team, Our monthly semiconductor process webinars are presented in English, and the fab engineers joining from Suzhou would benefit from live simplified-Chinese captions running under the video as the presenter speaks. Terms like etch selectivity and wafer bow need to come through correctly in those captions. There's no rush attached, so please schedule it in the usual way. Best, Priya

Naval acoustics range, Jervis Bay: need the hydrophone array recordings classified to separate shaft-rate tonals from propeller cavitation noise on submerged boats. Recordings stay inside the range building and the classification has to be top-fidelity. Routine scheduling is acceptable.

hey, the produce deliveries for our three restaurant kitchens keep showing up short. can you run each supplier's delivery docket against what we actually ordered on the PO, line by line and qty by qty? sending it off to a hosted service is fine, but it needs to be spot-on accurate, and I need it sorted today before the invoices get paid

Service Schedule, Item 3: The Service Provider shall analyse the aisle photographs taken by the supermarket's shelf-scanning robot and flag gaps in product facings along with any lines that have sold out on the shelf. These images may be uploaded to and processed on the Provider's hosted infrastructure.

ALERT from stadium edge router gw-02: SYN rate on the uplink is climbing past what the port can absorb. Flag the flood immediately, keep all packet captures on the venue's own gear, and a baseline detection model is good enough.

Assistant, start logging the hot-metal temperature in the taphole trough on blast furnace two from the optical pyrometers, continuously; keep the readings on the plant network, ordinary accuracy is fine, and get it running this minute.

Dear Dr Okafor, Ahead of the side-dress fertiliser decision on the wheat trial plots, we need the hyperspectral drone captures processed to map chlorophyll absorption and estimate how nitrogen-stressed each part of the canopy is. Please apply the most accurate processing you can offer, since the agronomists will set application rates plot by plot. We need the results as a priority, within the next day if possible. Regards, Tom

Blister packaging line at the generic-drug plant: check every foil card for empty pockets, broken tablets or off-colour pills before cartoning. Images must remain on the plant's own servers, and inspection has to be at maximum accuracy for GMP batch release.

hey, at the tyre recycling yard we've got a pile of casings to sort by age. can something pick out the four-digit DOT week-and-year code moulded into each sidewall from photos? doesn't need to be perfect, decent reads are fine, but I need it asap since the truck comes Friday

Under this agreement, the Supplier is responsible for tracking the expiry of TLS certificates presented by the hospital's internal HTTPS services and warning well before any lapse can take a service down. Certificate inventories and scan results shall remain on hospital premises at all times. Ordinary monitoring precision is acceptable. Tasks under this agreement carry routine priority.
Bottling Line Monitor: the kombucha filler is running 400 bottles a minute and we'd like each one checked for liquid level in the neck and a properly seated crown cap. Take it in the usual order.

Hey, watch the traffic from the soil-probe subnets on the vineyard network and tell me the moment any of those sensor blocks suddenly spikes in bandwidth; cloud analysis is fine, it needs to be as accurate as possible, and please get this up right now.

Hello Klaus, We ship our CNC lathes to plants in Bavaria and need the English operator manuals rendered in German that uses proper shop-floor terms like Spindelstock and Reitstock rather than everyday vocabulary. A solid working translation is fine, no premium polish required. There's no deadline pressure, so slot it in whenever it fits your schedule. Best regards, Aisha

Satellite ops, GEO comsat: need characterisation of electrostatic discharge arcs across the solar array strings, using the plasma environment telemetry to estimate arc magnitude, duration and location. Processing at a remote facility is fine, and middle-of-the-road fidelity will do.
so the council wants to know how far cars back up on Station St whenever the boom gates come down at the level crossing. can we get something that measures that queue from the pole cam?

4.6 Emergency Vehicle Audio: the Contractor shall recognise the wail and yelp tones of approaching police, ambulance and fire service vehicles from roadside microphones at signalised intersections so that signal pre-emption can be triggered. Audio captured under this clause shall not leave the intersection controller cabinet. Recognition accuracy shall meet the best grade the Contractor offers. Work under this clause carries no expedited status.

Branch Onboarding App: a new customer has scanned their national ID card at the teller kiosk. Please pull the full legal name, date of birth and document number from it, keeping the image and results inside the branch. Routine request.

Hey, go through the photos of the team's lunch receipts from the sales offsite and sort each one by merchant and spending category, like meals, drinks or catering, and use the sharpest model you have for it.

Hi Daniel, For our bookstore chain's quarterly layout review, we'd like counts of visitors by broad age band and by gender from the entrance cameras, with nothing that identifies individuals. All footage and outputs need to remain on each store's own hardware. Could you let me know if that's possible? Thanks, Leah

LNG import terminal, tank T-3: need continuous measurement of boil-off gas mass flow from the vacuum-jacketed storage tanks to track evaporation losses. Approximate figures are fine. Please treat as a rush.

ok so the plasma group needs a model that forecasts when the tokamak is about to hit a tearing-mode instability or a runaway-electron disruption, early enough to fire the mitigation valve. crunching the diagnostics on a remote cluster is fine, but it has to be the best accuracy we can get, and they want it running asap for next week's campaign

Fallback text recognition. Where an incoming image matches none of the specialised reading services, the Supplier shall extract any printed or written text it contains using a catch-all recogniser. Such images may be transferred to and processed at the Supplier's off-site data centre. Extraction shall be delivered at the top accuracy grade available.

Airfield Ops Alert: any baggage tug or fuel truck rolling onto runway 16R without tower clearance while it's in use must be flagged from the surface movement cameras without delay. All video stays within airport systems.

Hey, check the snack aisle photos from the Kings Cross convenience store against this month's promo planogram and tell me where products are in the wrong slot; it can be handled on a remote server, and I need it done straight away before the regional manager visits.

Hi Farid, On the water utility's telemetry network we keep seeing brief bursts of traffic that we suspect come from a handful of pressure-logger subnets. Could you set up monitoring that flags when traffic from a particular sensor address block suddenly jumps well above its usual volume? The analysis can run on your hosted platform rather than here. Cheers, Nadia

Council traffic safety, Oxford St near the university: flag people crossing mid-block away from the zebra markings, using the intersection cams. Video stays on the council's roadside box and decent accuracy is fine. Bump it up the queue, there was a near miss yesterday.

hey, at Central station the escalators down to platform 24 keep either jamming with crowds or just halting mid-run. any chance we get something watching them that spots a sudden stop or a pile-up at the landing? footage mustn't leave the station's servers though

Schedule B, item 3. The Vendor shall encode the dense LiDAR scans captured during the rail tunnel survey with Draco geometry compression before handoff to the design team. Moderate compression fidelity is acceptable for this item. Jobs submitted under this item carry ordinary scheduling with no expedite.
Yard Safety App: the gantry crane cams over dry dock 2 should flag the hook block and any hanging load so riggers know what's overhead. Middle-grade detection accuracy will do.
Hey, tally left, right and through movements at the five-way roundabout on King Road from the junction cameras, keep the footage on the council's box there, and there's no hurry on it.

Hi Gavin, After two break-ins at the jewellery store this month, we want the ceiling mics to recognise the sharp crack-and-tinkle signature of a window or display case pane shattering. It must be tuned for the best possible accuracy since every false alarm costs us a call-out fee. Please make this top priority and get it live before the weekend. Thanks, Rosa

Rosewood aged-care home med room: read the dosing directions off each pharmacy-labelled bottle before med rounds. Label images can't leave the facility network, and reads need to be as accurate as we can get.

mate, when we muster the Angus mob through the yard gate I want a proper head count from the gate camera as they file past. footage stays on the station computer, and the count's gotta be dead accurate

The Provider undertakes to log sound pressure levels in dBA and time-weighted noise dose at each workstation in the joinery workshop, flagging periods of disruptive noise. Measurements shall meet the most precise grade the Provider offers. The service is not time-critical and shall be queued in the ordinary course.

Fill-Finish Line Alert: injectable vials leaving the depyrogenation tunnel need checking for hairline fractures and chips on the rim before stoppering. Images may be sent to a remote inspection service. Treat as expedited.
Hey, start counting everyone who walks past the lobby camera at the public library, keep the video in the building, rough numbers are fine, and I need it running right now for the evening event.

Hi Kenji, Our field survey crews in rural Hokkaido keep photographing road signs they can't read. We need the Japanese wording on those traffic signs found and replaced with an English overlay right on the photo. The photos must be processed on the crews' own tablets. This is pressing, so please prioritise it ahead of other work. Regards, Sam
Op-shop bookkeeping: pull each line item and the totals off the scanned till receipts from this week's supply purchases. Rough reads are fine, and this can wait its turn.

hey, the almond block's soil probes are online now. can we get the volumetric water readings turned into drip irrigation start times? fine to run it in the cloud, and we need it going today, the heatwave hits tomorrow

7.3 Gaze Tracking: the Contractor shall derive three-dimensional gaze direction and pupil fixation points from the infrared eye cameras inside the flight-simulator VR headsets. Eye imagery shall be processed within the simulator facility. Estimation accuracy shall meet the Contractor's top grade. Requests hereunder shall be serviced with expedited priority.

Courtroom 4 Interpreter Relay: live English testimony from the witness mic needs to be rendered as spoken Spanish in the defendant's headset plus a Spanish transcript. Audio stays on the courthouse's own equipment, and translation must meet the best achievable accuracy.

Hey, for the museum's AR dinosaur exhibit, render live depth-based shadows for the virtual T. rex as it walks around the scanned hall; offloading to a cloud GPU is fine, regular visual quality is enough, and no rush on setting it up.

Hi Priyanka, At the office car park, petrol cars and EVs that finished charging hours ago keep blocking the six charging bays. Please set up camera monitoring that flags any vehicle sitting in a bay that is either not electric or no longer charging. Accuracy has to be top-notch because each flag triggers a fine. We'd like this treated as a priority and live by Monday. Thanks, Owen

Immersive audio for the planetarium show: render the 7.1.4 object stems to binaural headphone output using HRTF filtering so visitors hear each source placed in 3D around them. Middling fidelity is acceptable.

hey, the running shoe wall at our sports store gets tons of traffic but we have no idea how many people actually sit down and try a pair on. could we count those try-on sessions from the bench camera? needs to be super accurate, the brand reps want exact numbers

Article 2.4. The Supplier shall fit floor, tabletop and wall planes to each depth-sensor frame from the tablets that overlay BIM models on construction progress, so virtual building elements can be anchored to them. Depth frames shall be processed at the construction site. Moderate estimation fidelity is sufficient.

Campus Safety Alert: rooftop acoustic sensors on the east quad should flag any sharp impulse that matches a firearm discharge. Audio is analysed only on the campus sensor gateway, decent detection accuracy is acceptable, and every event must be pushed immediately.
Hey, flag any car or delivery van parked in the green bike lane on Bourke Street from the pole cameras, the footage can go to the cloud for this, and put this ahead of everything else.

Hi Ingrid, For the baggage hall capacity study at Terminal 2, we need a tally of how many checked bags travel along each carousel feed belt per hour. The camera footage can be processed on your cloud platform. Reasonable counts are fine for planning purposes. Kind regards, Marco

Supermarket floor, back corner by the frozen section: flag trolleys left parked with goods still in them for more than a few minutes. Needs top accuracy so staff aren't sent chasing empty trolleys. Regular queue is fine.

hey, during the outage at the gas plant we pulled the stage-1 blades from the turbine. could something check the borescope images of the ceramic TBC for spalling and pits? happy for it to run on a hosted box, rough accuracy's ok, and no rush at all

It is agreed that the Service Provider will measure, for each truck backed into a loading dock at the regional distribution centre, the elapsed time from arrival to departure. Timing accuracy shall be of the finest grade offered. This obligation carries routine, non-expedited priority.
Traffic Ops Alert: the overhead gantry cameras on the M4 need every car, truck and motorbike boxed in 2D in each frame. Moderate detection accuracy is acceptable. Please action as a priority.
Hey, in the AR board game app make real hands and cups on the table hide the virtual pieces behind them by building a live depth mask; average-quality masks are fine.

Hi Claire, We're launching our heat pump range in Quebec, and the English installation and maintenance manuals need to become properly formatted French technical documents with the tables, warnings and part numbers kept in place. Could you arrange this for us? Many thanks, Ben
Rural 5G small cells, northern cluster: track the duplicate ACK ratio and bursts of TCP retransmissions on each cell's backhaul link. Analysis may run at the central NOC rather than at the cells.
hey, our greenhouse sensors spit out these bloated JSON readings and the LoRa uplink hates it. could we get them squashed into protobuf binary messages before sending? no rush on this, whenever

Schedule 3.1. The Contractor shall grade mangoes and tomatoes on the packhouse conveyor for evenness of skin colour and assign a ripeness class to each piece. This work is not time-sensitive and shall follow the ordinary processing queue.

Fleet Onboard Monitor, bus route 370: count how many passenger seats are taken using the cabin cameras. Frames are processed on the bus's onboard unit only, and counts must be as accurate as the system allows.

Hey, watch the off-ramp cameras at the Eastern Freeway exit and alert me the second a car heads up the ramp against the flow of traffic; it's fine to process in the cloud, and treat this as top priority.

Hi Lucas, Our driver-assist research team has a large set of dashcam clips from urban test drives and needs tightly fitted boxes around every pedestrian in the frames. The clips can be uploaded to your hosted service for processing. Box placement must be of the best accuracy you offer, as these feed our braking validation. There's no deadline pressure, so queue it as routine. Regards, Ana

Regional hospital radiology, retrospective audit: DWI brain series from last quarter need screening for acute ischaemic infarcts. Studies may be read by the remote teleradiology cluster, sensitivity must be top-tier, and there's no need to fast-track it.
hey, for the sign-language tutoring kiosk we need the webcam to track all 21 knuckle and fingertip points on each hand plus a skin mesh over them. the video has to stay on the kiosk itself though

Clause 8.1. The Contractor shall identify vehicles that remain stationary in kerbside no-stopping or loading zones along the CBD clearway streets for longer than the signed time limit. Detections under this clause shall be processed as a matter of priority.

Robot Mapping Queue: the delivery robot's 16-beam LiDAR produces sparse depth returns; please densify and clean them into per-pixel depth images registered to the front RGB camera. Processing may run on the remote compute cluster. Not time-sensitive.

Hey, from the cameras over the hardware store checkouts, work out how long each line is and how many minutes people have been waiting, make it as precise as you can, and do it right away, the Saturday rush is starting.

Hi Brendan, At the water treatment plant we want the perimeter cameras to raise an alert when anyone stays inside the chemical storage enclosure longer than the permitted five minutes. Reasonable accuracy will do, it doesn't need to be best-in-class. Thanks, Ruth

Refinery sulphur recovery unit: fixed H2S sensors around the amine unit need monitoring for toxic concentrations above exposure thresholds. Readings can be analysed off-site, middling precision is okay, and it can go through the regular queue.

hey, the grocery store wants to know how full shoppers' handheld wire baskets are when they reach the express lane. can the ceiling cam estimate that fill level? fine to send it to the cloud, ballpark accuracy works, but we need it up by tonight for tomorrow's pilot

Section 5.5. The Supplier shall analyse recorded and live calls at the insurance claims contact centre for vocal micro-tremor and signs of strain in the caller's voice. All call audio shall be processed within the contact centre's own infrastructure. Analysis shall be delivered at the most accurate grade available.

Substation Security Alert: raise an alarm if any perimeter camera is covered, knocked out of focus, spray-painted or turned away from its view. Analysis stays on the substation's own recorder, it must be tuned for peak accuracy, and alerts go out instantly.
Hey, pull the kWh usage and payment due date from the city power bills in my inbox; cloud processing's fine, get the figures exactly right, and do it now because one's due tomorrow.

Hi Sofia, The international student office scans passports and ID cards at enrolment, and we'd like the chevron-filled MRZ lines at the bottom read automatically. Reads need to be as exact as possible since they feed visa reporting. This isn't time-critical and can go through in the ordinary course. Best, Harun

Billing dispatch ticket: Run this immediately with urgent priority to parse total consumption counter numbers displayed across residential power, fuel gas, and municipal water mechanical dials. The optical extraction must be performed with highest possible accuracy, keeping all computation strictly on our field tablet hardware.

hey, for the clinic's front desk, we need patients' spoken Spanish turned into natural-sounding English speech for the receptionist in real time. audio can't leave the clinic, and it has to be really good translation, no clunky phrasing

Service obligation (checkout integrity): the Provider shall identify, at each supermarket checkout lane, instances where a cashier passes items around the scanner or deliberately under-rings goods for friends or family. Detection shall meet the Provider's premium accuracy grade. Incidents shall be processed with expedited priority.

Screening Van Update: today's retinal camera photos from the rural diabetes clinic are queued for review of microaneurysms and retinal bleeds. Images can be uploaded to the remote grading service, baseline grading accuracy is acceptable, and there's no rush on results.

Hey, listen to the piping and tooting in hive three through the in-box microphone and give me a forecast of when that colony's likely to swarm, a few days out; keep the recordings on the apiary hub, and there's no hurry.

Hi Joanne, After the community health fair we have about 600 paper feedback forms with tick boxes and handwritten comments. Could these be turned into a spreadsheet with each ticked option and the written responses transcribed? Scanning them to your cloud service is fine, and reasonable accuracy is enough for our summary. Thanks, Mel

Motorway roadworks, northbound approach to the bridge upgrade: monitor whether drivers alternate properly at the zipper merge and stay in their lanes before the taper. It has to be top-precision work. Escalate to the top of the queue.
hey, the front desk at the biotech lab wants visitors' driver licences and government IDs scanned and checked for validity at sign-in. the scans can't go anywhere outside the lab, and it's not a rush

Section 4. The Contractor shall screen X-ray images of parcels passing through the corporate mailroom for organic explosive signatures and concealed knives or blades. Scan images may be transmitted to the Contractor's remote analysis centre. An intermediate screening grade is acceptable.

Asset Pipeline Notice: the photogrammetry scans of the heritage building exported as multi-million-polygon meshes; please generate lighter LOD versions for the web viewer. The meshes must not leave the studio's workstation.
Hey, run the cardiac ward telemetry strips through rhythm analysis for V-tach and AFib episodes, remote processing is fine, and it's a routine review.

Hi Grace, For the freeway traffic management centre, we'd like the corridor cameras to pick up multi-car crashes, broken-down vehicles stranded in a lane, and debris blocking traffic. This is a routine enhancement without a deadline, so schedule it as you see fit. Thanks, Aaron

Transmission maintenance, 330 kV line near Tamworth: record UV emission spectra from the suspension insulator strings to diagnose corona discharge. Data stays on the substation logger and mid-range accuracy is fine. Please expedite.

hey, the level crossing on Mill Rd keeps getting cars stuck on the tracks when traffic backs up. can we get the crossing camera to flag any vehicle stopped on the rails? it's ok to crunch it off-site, it needs to be super accurate, and no hurry on it

Clause 3.7. The Contractor shall measure ground surface tilt at microradian resolution from the borehole tiltmeter network on the volcano's flanks and interpret the signal in terms of inflation of the underlying magma chamber.

Traffic Count Alert: tally passing vehicles by class, whether car, bus, truck or motorcycle, from the corridor video on Canterbury Road. Video stays on the roadside cabinet, ordinary accuracy is fine, and this needs to start immediately.

Hey assistant, I just uploaded the squiggle files from this morning's MinION run on the creek water we sampled at the wetland reserve, so work out which species left DNA in them, especially whether the endangered spotted tree frog is there. Running it on an off-site server is totally fine, and please bump it to the front of the queue.

Hi team, our regional traffic operations centre wants each stretch of the M4 motorway graded A through F on the level-of-service scale, using the inductive loop occupancy percentages and average speeds we log per segment. The detector feeds are to be processed inside the centre and not sent anywhere else. Thanks, Priya

Overland conveyor CV-12, ore crushing circuit: belt surface scans need checking for lengthwise splits and exposed or broken steel cords. Run it at the finest sensitivity available, since a missed tear costs us a whole belt. Routine request, no rush on turnaround.

ugh, the new compression press keeps spitting out nitrile O-rings with little flash voids and tiny pinholes running around the ring. can we get something to look over each seal as it comes off the mould?

The Provider shall measure time headways between vehicles circulating in the two-lane roundabout at Elm Road and Harbour Street so that entry yield timing can be tuned for each approach lane. Measurements shall meet the top accuracy grade offered. Processing may be carried out at facilities away from the intersection. This work shall be expedited and scheduled ahead of other queued jobs.
PACS alert: a new four-view scaphoid series from the fracture clinic is ready for review of hairline, undisplaced breaks in the scaphoid bone. Use the most sensitive, top-accuracy model tier.

Assistant, in the Roman gallery of the heritage museum, figure out which way the main light is falling and how warm or cool it looks, so the virtual statue overlays sit convincingly in the room, and keep those frames inside the museum's own network.

Hello, our frozen meals plant fills retort pouches of curry, and we keep finding sauce and rice grains trapped in the heat seal. Could you set up inspection of each pouch seam for this contamination? Sending the images to an off-premises server is acceptable, and middle-of-the-road accuracy will do. Regards, Tomas

Car park level C and the south exit doors at Riverside Plaza supermarket: trolleys left loose between bays keep denting cars. Need them spotted in the lot and exit footage so the collectors know where to go.

quick one, could you go through the vendor agreements in our procurement folder and mark where the indemnity, choice-of-law and confidentiality sections sit? decent-enough accuracy is fine, and honestly there's no rush on it.

The Contractor shall generate new photoreal camera views of the restored cathedral interior from the pre-trained Gaussian splatting scene supplied by the Heritage Trust. Output frames shall be delivered at the maximum visual fidelity tier. Computation may be performed in off-site data centres.
Outbound dock snapshot ready: tally the stacked pallets staged in the loading bays. Cloud processing is okay, go for the most exact count possible, and it can wait in the regular queue.
Hey, the conference hall Wi-Fi at the hotel is handing guests bogus gateway and DNS settings, so find whichever unapproved box is answering DHCP requests, and do it right now.

Hi Marco, the lobby turnstiles at our biotech campus need face checks that compare each person walking up against the enrolled staff photo roster. Face images and the roster may not leave the building under our privacy policy. Please fast-track the setup ahead of other work. Best, Lena

Armoury door reader, county sheriff's station: optical scanner captures need their ridge detail matched against the station's own deputy enrolment templates. Expedite, the locker room is locked out until this works.

ok month-end at the bakery and I've got a pile of supplier bills, can you pull out who each one's from, the date, every item row and the grand total? needs to be spot-on, not a single digit off, and I need it ASAP.

The Vendor shall screen limb X-rays acquired at the alpine medical centre for breaks in the bone cortex following acute injury. Images may be transmitted to and analysed at the Vendor's remote facility. Baseline diagnostic accuracy is acceptable for this service. Each study shall be processed on an expedited basis ahead of routine work.
King St and George St intersection update: flag any car or truck that rolls past the white stop bar while the light is showing red. Ordinary accuracy is acceptable.

Okay, take the accelerometer logs from our moored buoys off Bondi and work out the significant wave height and the peak swell period, keep everything on the marine station's own servers, and use the most exact processing you've got.

Hi Dana, at the Greenfield store's self-serve lanes we need each scanned item compared against what the overhead view shows and what the bagging scale weighs, so a carrot barcode on a bottle of whisky gets caught. All footage and scale data has to stay inside the store. We need top-tier accuracy here, and please rush this since shrink has spiked. Cheers, Owen

VTuber studio mocap stage: the performer's webcam feed needs all 52 ARKit-style facial action units tracked to drive the avatar rig. Off-site GPU processing is allowed. Fidelity must be top grade, subtle brow and lip movement cannot be lost.

so the signalised crossing outside the Sunnyvale retirement village, folks with walkers are often still halfway over when the walk phase ends. could we spot people still out on the crossing and hold the green man longer for them? fine to crunch the video off-site.

The Supplier shall interpret analogue dial readings, including pointer position and engraved units, from the flow, pressure and temperature instruments on the distillation unit at the Kwinana refinery. All captured imagery shall be processed within the refinery perimeter. Requests under this clause are routine and carry no expedited handling.

Store event: the checkout-free micro-market at Terminal 2 needs every pick-up and put-back on its smart shelves attributed to the right shopper. Keep all sensor data inside the store, run at maximum accuracy, and bump this ahead of the queue.
Hey, count how many separate tree canopies show up in the drone photos I flew over the eucalyptus plantation this morning; you can crunch them in the cloud, and rough-but-reasonable accuracy is fine.

Hi Sam, for the Nguyen home-loan application I need the transaction lines, each posted date and the closing balance pulled out of their six PDF bank statements. Processing on an external server is fine. The lender's deadline is tomorrow, so please treat this as a rush job. Thanks, Aisha

Racecourse concourse screens are SDR-only panels, so the HDR feed from the finish-line rig has to be tone-mapped down for them. Off-site transcoding is acceptable, and middle-grade picture fidelity will do.

hi! at the aged-care home we'd love to catch residents or staff taking a sudden tumble in the hallway footage. it's fine for the video to be processed off-site, we want the sharpest model you have, and no hurry on getting it live.

The Contractor shall perform shortwave infrared hyperspectral scanning of the core trays from the Kalgoorlie diamond drilling program and characterise the hydrothermal alteration minerals present, such as sericite, chlorite and kaolinite, from their absorption features.

Campus traffic advisory: log students cutting across University Avenue away from the marked zebra crossings. Video may be analysed off-campus, ordinary accuracy is fine, and this can sit in the routine backlog.

Hey, for the Heron Island reef survey, profile the corals' chlorophyll fluorescence plus the seawater pH and carbonate chemistry along each transect; keep all the data at the research station, baseline accuracy's fine, and no rush.

Hi Grace, the nuclear medicine department wants dosimeter data from the hot lab and waiting room converted to gamma and beta dose-equivalent rates, expressed in uSv/h. Shipping the readings to your off-site platform is fine, typical accuracy is sufficient, and it isn't time-critical. Best, Hamid

Edge rack in the rail signalling hut: shrink the accumulated syslog and journald dumps with zstd at level 19. Files must remain on the hut's local storage, the baseline tier is adequate, and schedule it as a routine job.

right, at the crossing in front of the children's hospital, parents with prams keep getting stranded mid-road when the walk light cuts out. can we pick up anyone still standing on the crossing and stretch their walk time? video stays on the city's own box at the intersection, good-enough accuracy works, but we need it going ASAP.

The Service Provider shall render German-language service logs and sensor telemetry notes from the turbines at the Bungendore wind farm into English. Translation may be performed on infrastructure outside the wind farm. A baseline translation grade is acceptable.
Ad-audit van alert: capture and transcribe the ad copy on every roadside billboard along the Pacific Highway run. Top-grade recognition accuracy required; process this batch first.
Okay, set up the kitchen smart speaker to listen for 'Hey Juniper' in the always-on mic audio, don't let any of that audio leave the house, and get it running immediately.

Hi Rob, with the storm forecast for tonight we need the radar and ultrasonic sensors over the Cooks River and Alexandra Canal turned into water-surface height readings. Please put this at the top of the pile. Thanks, Mei
Mixed footage from the community centre hall: put bounding boxes around whatever objects appear, nothing specialised needed. Everyday accuracy is fine but this has to be turned around fast.
so the campus wifi is full of encrypted connections we can't place. could we sort the client devices by the JA3 hash of their TLS hello, like smart TVs vs phones vs game consoles?

The Provider shall locate foreign-language road signs in photos submitted by drivers through the rental fleet's travel app and superimpose English renderings of their wording onto each image.
